vulnerable_code:
class Billing::InvoicesController < ApplicationController
  def create
    # Strong parameters permit organization_id, allowing tenant reassignment
    @invoice = Invoice.new(invoice_params)
    if @invoice.save
      render json: @invoice, status: :created
    else
      render json: @invoice.errors, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  private

  def invoice_params
    params.require(:invoice).permit(:amount, :due_date, :client_id, :organization_id)
  end
end
diagnosis: The invoice_params method permits organization_id from HTTP request payloads. An attacker can create fraudulent billing invoices attached to other organizations, routing payouts or charging expenses to victim tenant accounts.

corrected_code:
class Billing::InvoicesController < ApplicationController
  def create
    @invoice = current_organization.invoices.build(invoice_params)
    if @invoice.save
      render json: @invoice, status: :created
    else
      render json: @invoice.errors, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  private

  def invoice_params
    params.require(:invoice).permit(:amount, :due_date, :client_id)
  end
end
